title.en: Daily practice resets without losing course-day progress
title.zh: 每日练习跨日刷新且保留课程日进度

purpose.en: Restore a fresh server-graded five-skill practice set and daily quiz after learner-local midnight while preserving an unfinished timed course checkpoint.
purpose.zh: 在学习者本地午夜后恢复全新的服务器判分五技能练习和每日测验，同时保留未完成的计时课程检查点。

en: Generate reading, writing, listening, and dialogue task identities from the current learner-local date.
Generate and look up the daily vocabulary quiz by the current learner-local date.
Discard quiz answers restored from an earlier local date before hydration or submission.
Validate quiz practice dates independently from retained checkpoint dates.
Keep the existing cross-device course-day plan and draft checkpoint resumable across dates.
zh: 按学习者当前本地日期生成阅读、写作、听力和对话任务标识。
按学习者当前本地日期生成并查询每日词汇测验。
在恢复或提交前丢弃来自较早本地日期的测验答案。
分别校验测验练习日期与保留的检查点日期。
继续允许跨日期恢复既有的跨设备课程日计划和草稿检查点。

en: Signed-in Beginner course learning workspace
Daily five-skill practice
Daily vocabulary quiz and score log
Cross-device course-day draft synchronization
Project release report
zh: 已登录初级课程学习工作区
每日五技能练习
每日词汇测验与成绩日志
跨设备课程日草稿同步
Project 发布报告

en: Separate the current practice date from the authoritative checkpoint date in the learning API.
Use the practice date for task status, sentence rounds, quiz questions, quiz attempts, and quiz images.
Filter checkpoint-restored quiz answers against the current server-assigned question identifiers.
Persist both practice and checkpoint dates in quiz receipts so cross-midnight retries remain verifiable.
Use the checkpoint date only for checkpoint scope validation and persistence.
zh: 在学习 API 中拆分当前练习日期与权威检查点日期。
任务状态、组句轮次、测验题目、测验记录和测验图片统一使用练习日期。
根据服务器当前分配的题目标识过滤从检查点恢复的测验答案。
在测验回执中同时保存练习日期与检查点日期，使跨午夜重试仍可验证。
仅在检查点范围校验和持久化中使用检查点日期。

en: Run regressions proving a new local date produces fresh practice, retains the prior checkpoint, and excludes prior-date quiz answers.
Run the sentence catalog, placement-learning, and 21-day QA contract suites.
Run the full repository test, build, artifact, migration, sensitive-data, and shared-site policy gates.
After deployment, repeat the failed signed-in Chrome course and quiz steps and verify fresh tasks, feedback, score, and the 2026-08-22 learning log.
zh: 运行回归测试，证明新本地日期会产生新练习、保留旧检查点并排除旧日期测验答案。
运行句子目录、分级学习及 21 天 QA 合同测试。
运行完整仓库测试、构建、产物、迁移、敏感信息及共享站点政策门禁。
发布后在已登录 Chrome 中重测失败的课程与测验步骤，并验证新题、反馈、成绩及 2026-08-22 学习日志。

en: Microphone-dependent speech scoring remains subject to Chrome device permission and will be reported as blocked if unavailable during production acceptance.
zh: 依赖麦克风的口语评分仍取决于 Chrome 设备权限；若生产验收时不可用，将如实记录为阻断。

en: SmartLingo retains its 60-minute resumable course-day timer while independently rotating daily acceptance exercises at learner-local midnight.
zh: SmartLingo 保留可恢复的 60 分钟课程日计时器，同时在学习者本地午夜独立轮换每日验收练习。
